drafted_from: tools/find-media-for-a-description/tool-rows.json, do-work/find_media.mjs, do-work/bank-provider.mjs and test/find-media.test.mjs (bank provider, run on a made-up media folder)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Find a clip of boats at sunrise in my media folder /tmp/media-bank and save it as /tmp/picked.mp4." It writes a request file, runs the finder with the bank provider and tells you which file it picked.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one folder of your own media (or the stock libraries) and copies the best match to a file.
instructions: 1. For your own media, give each file you want found an optional sidecar <file>.tags.json holding {"tags": ["harbour", "boats"]}; for stock, have your key for each library in the environment variable read-data/stock-sources.json names (never type the value).
2. Write a request file: {"provider": "bank", "description": "boats at sunrise", "kind": "clip", "bank_dir": "/tmp/media-bank", "out": "/tmp/picked.mp4"} (provider stock needs no bank_dir).
3. Say "Find media for this description"; your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: node trillion-workshop/tools/find-media-for-a-description/do-work/find_media.mjs < request.json.

4. Read the last line {"result": {provider, file, request}} for the saved file. A refusal prints why and exits non-zero (2 unknown provider, 3 kind not offered, 4 nothing found or licence not offered); then try the other provider.

worked_examples.title: Pick the best-tagged clip from my own folder
worked_examples.ask: Find a clip of boats at sunrise in my media folder.
worked_examples.given: Run on a made-up folder (the case of test/find-media.test.mjs 'bank provider finds a tagged clip end to end'). /tmp/media-bank holds harbour-sunrise.mp4 with harbour-sunrise.mp4.tags.json {"tags": ["harbour", "boats", "sunrise"]} and forest-path.mp4 with tags nature, trees. request.json is {"provider":"bank","description":"boats at sunrise","kind":"clip","bank_dir":"/tmp/media-bank","out":"/tmp/picked.mp4"}. The AI runs: node trillion-workshop/tools/find-media-for-a-description/do-work/find_media.mjs < request.json
worked_examples.hands_back: harbour-sunrise.mp4 is copied to /tmp/picked.mp4 (match score 3; forest-path.mp4 is not touched), and the last line is {"result": {"provider": "bank", "file": "/tmp/picked.mp4", "request": {"provider": "bank", "description": "boats at sunrise", "kind": "clip", "bank_dir": "/tmp/media-bank", "out": "/tmp/picked.mp4"}}}.
